title: Redesign explicit PDS-managed publishing with caller-selected record keys
description: Future alternative to the primary Leaflet-managed lifecycle; the pre-reset publish run implementation is historical recovery evidence at revision 80436b61, while the ATProto library remains retained; the current CLI has no implemented PDS publish workflow. Carry that capability into the document-centered redesign deliberately: consume the current managed MDX document through an explicit public-record projection and strip local @leafspring state from the wire output, choose/validate an initial rkey explicitly rather than deriving it from filename, persist actual AT URI as identity, preserve it on updates, and surface path/routing constraints. A document has one chosen management mode, never simultaneous independent Leaflet/PDS writers. Preview the identity and the native lifecycle differences (application/editor linkage, publish versioning, revalidation, newsletter/mention/share behavior); do not assume firehose ingestion reproduces every native side effect or silently substitute this path for failed native publication. Acceptance: design and implementation of the explicit PDS-managed first-publication path with offline transport tests, key collision/conditional-create behavior, envelope stripping, identity preservation, and precise lifecycle tradeoff documentation. No live writes without separate operator authorization. Origin: opencode://ses_e4900b8d7ffeDT9QuFwmKRAB7t, user-requested PDS alternative during redesign round 1.
notes:
Round-1 source verification: Leaflet 600c7b5f resolveDocumentFilter.ts matches actual publication-scoped record path before rkey fallback, so rkey/path need not inherently be equal for publication routing.
